title: 366. Ugly Number II

examples.explanation: The first ten ugly numbers are [1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12], so the tenth is 12.
After 12 comes 15, since 11, 13 and 14 all contain other prime factors.

hints: Every ugly number after 1 is twice, three times or five times an earlier ugly number.
Keep three pointers into the built list for multiples of 2, 3 and 5, and always take the smallest candidate next.
Advance every pointer whose candidate equals the chosen value so duplicates appear only once.
